migration.export_warning_sage50.en: Tick Include Headings on the Options tab of each template before exporting: Celerp recognises every file by its column names.

migration.export_range_sage50_trial_bala.en: As of the last day of each fiscal year and of the last transaction, and the day before the first transaction if the books have beginning balances

migration.err_export_damaged.en: These {source} files cannot be read: a value in them is not one {source} writes, so they are damaged or were changed after exporting. Nothing was imported. Export the files again from {source} and upload the new ones.

migration.err_sage50_distributions.en: {where}: the transaction says it holds {count} lines, but the rows that follow do not hold that many lines of the same transaction. Export the {label} again.

migration.err_sage50_unbalanced.en: {where} does not balance: its lines differ by {difference}. Export the {label} again.

migration.err_sage50_contact_missing.en: The {label} names IDs the {list} does not list: {ids}. Export the {list} again with inactive records included.

migration.err_sage50_tb_last.en: No {label} is as of {date}, the date of the last transaction, or later. Add one as of that day.

migration.err_sage50_currency.en: Choose the currency these books are kept in before importing them.

migration.sage50_currency_question.en: Currency these books are kept in

migration.sage50_employee_note.en: Celerp does not keep employee records. Payroll checks are not in Sage 50's exports; the import check shows where they leave the trial balance.

migration.sage50_stock_note.en: Sage 50 does not export quantities on hand. The items are imported; count their stock in Celerp after the import.

migration.sage50_tax_unassigned_note.en: The lines of these invoices have different Sage 50 tax types, and Sage 50 does not export which tax types are taxable, so each invoice's sales tax is imported as one tax line on it. Its total and its tax total are unchanged.

migration.sage50_absent_general.en: Without the General Journal no general journal entries are imported, so a full history import cannot run. Upload it, even an export with no transactions, or import from a cutover date.

migration.sage50_absent_sales.en: Without the Sales Journal no invoice or credit memo history is imported, so a full history import cannot run. Upload it, even an export with no transactions, or import from a cutover date.

migration.sage50_absent_receipts.en: Without the Cash Receipts Journal no receipts are imported, so a full history import cannot run. Upload it, even an export with no transactions, or import from a cutover date.

migration.sage50_absent_purchases.en: Without the Purchase Journal no purchase or vendor credit memo history is imported, so a full history import cannot run. Upload it, even an export with no transactions, or import from a cutover date.

migration.sage50_absent_payments.en: Without the Cash Disbursements Journal no payments are imported, so a full history import cannot run. Upload it, even an export with no transactions, or import from a cutover date.

migration.sage50_accepts.en: From Sage 50 or Peachtree (US edition, 2010 or later), export and upload together (as the files or one zip): 1. Open File > Select Import/Export. 2. For each template, choose it, select Export, tick Include Headings on the Options tab, set the date range to All, and save the file: the Chart of Accounts List, the Customer List, the Vendor List, the Inventory Item List, the Employee List, and the General, Sales, Cash Receipts, Purchase and Cash Disbursements Journals. 3. In Reports & Forms, export to Excel a General Ledger Trial Balance as of the last day of each fiscal year and of the last transaction (and the day before the first transaction if the books have beginning balances), and the Aged Receivables and Aged Payables reports as of the last transaction. Payroll checks, inventory adjustments and the cost of goods sold Sage 50 posts for stock items are not in these exports; the import check shows where they leave the trial balance.

migration.err_export_column_twice.en: {name} holds the column {column} twice, so its values cannot be told apart. Export it again and upload the new file.

migration.err_export_value_unheaded.en: {name}: the value "{value}" sits in a column with no heading. Export the file again with its headings and upload the new file.

migration.err_export_precision.en: {where}: {value} carries more decimal places than {currency} keeps ({places}). Check that these books are kept in {currency}.

migration.err_export_reference_ambiguous.en: {contact} holds more than one document numbered {number}, so a payment, credit or report naming {number} could mean either. Give each its own number in the source and export the set again.

migration.err_sage50_flag.en: {where}: "{value}" in {column} is neither TRUE nor FALSE. Export the file again.

migration.err_sage50_tax_type.en: {where}: "{value}" is not a Sage 50 Tax Type, a whole number from 0 to 27. Export the Sales Journal again.

migration.err_sage50_id_twice.en: {name} ({label}) lists the ID {id} twice. Export it again and upload the new file.

migration.err_sage50_agency_accounts.en: The sales tax of {agency} posts to two accounts, {accounts} (the second in {where}). Post each tax agency's tax to one account in Sage 50 and export the Sales Journal again.

migration.err_sage50_due.en: {where} gives no Date Due. Sage 50 requires one on every invoice and purchase: export the {label} again.

migration.sage50_quote_note.en: Quotes post nothing in Sage 50 and are not imported.

migration.sage50_beginning_note.en: Sage 50 keeps customer and vendor beginning balances outside its general ledger, whose beginning balances the trial balance carries, so they are not imported as invoices or purchases. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after they are paid.

migration.sage50_voided_note.en: These transactions were voided in Sage 50. What each posted is imported as a journal entry, so every account ends at Sage 50's balance, but not as an invoice, purchase, receipt or payment. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after them.

migration.sage50_retainage_note.en: These invoices or purchases hold back retainage, which Celerp does not keep on a document. What each posted is imported as a journal entry, so every account ends at Sage 50's balance. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after them.

migration.err_sage50_inconsistent.en: {where}: the lines of this transaction give different values for {column}. Export the {label} again.

migration.err_sage50_retain_column.en: {where}: a line of Tax Type 27, freight or retainage in Sage 50, cannot be told apart without the Retain Percent column. Export the {label} again with every column.

migration.err_sage50_row_type.en: {where}: "{value}" is not a Sage 50 Row Type, a whole number. Export the Purchase Journal again.

migration.sage50_waiting_note.en: These purchases were received before their vendor bills, which Sage 50 keeps apart from bills ready to pay. What each posted is imported as a journal entry, so every account ends at Sage 50's balance, but not as a bill. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after their bills were entered.

migration.sage50_refund_note.en: These refunds were applied to a credit memo, which Celerp settles only from its own side's receipts and payments. Each refund is imported as a journal entry on its customer or vendor, so every balance ends at Sage 50's, but its credit memo stays open. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after them.

migration.sage50_unread_note.en: These transactions fill a Sage 50 field Celerp does not read, so it cannot tell what they are. What each posted is imported as a journal entry, so every account ends at Sage 50's balance. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after them.

migration.err_sage50_total_paid.en: {where}: the total paid on invoices, {total}, is not what its lines apply to invoices, {applied}. Export the {label} again.

migration.sage50_prepayment_note.en: These advance payments are kept on the customer or vendor as credit, but Celerp holds no prepayment to apply to a later invoice. What each posted is imported as a journal entry, so every balance ends at Sage 50's. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after they were applied.

migration.sage50_unmatched_note.en: These receipts and payments are applied to a record the export does not hold as an invoice or purchase, such as a prepayment. Each is imported as a journal entry on its customer or vendor, so every balance ends at Sage 50's, but settles nothing. A full history import cannot run: import from a cutover date after them.

migration.err_sage50_unmatched_account.en: {where} is applied to {paid}, which the export holds no invoice or purchase for, and leaves its G/L Account empty, so the account it posts to is not stated. Upload the journal that holds {paid} with every transaction included, or export the {label} again with that line's G/L Account.

error.payment_stripe_owned.en: This payment was received through Stripe, so it can only be refunded or reversed in Stripe.

error.payment_not_named.en: A payment can be taken off a document only by naming it, and a deletion keeps its place.

import.err_choose_header_row.en: Choose the row that holds the column names.

import.err_sheet_required.en: This file has more than one sheet with data. Choose the sheet to import.

import.err_header_duplicate.en: Columns {first} and {column} have the same header {header}; give each column its own header.

error.origin_ambiguous.en: Document {doc} was recorded against more than one {role} account ({codes}), so Celerp cannot tell which one to use. The books check lists it for correction.

inventory.err_legacy_cogs_no_entry.en: but the invoice has no posted entry of its own, so its cost of goods sold cannot be adjusted automatically; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_legacy_cogs_unroled.en: whose entries hold a line on an account with no posting role, so whether its cost of goods sold was posted cannot be told; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_legacy_cogs_pending.en: whose cost of goods sold Celerp has not posted yet; it is posted the next time Celerp starts, after which the cost can be corrected

inventory.err_legacy_cogs_ambiguous.en: whose cost of goods sold was never posted because its lines cannot be matched to exact lots; correct it with a journal entry instead

documents.err_line_two_items.en: Line {line} names two different items ({item} and {other}). Keep one item per line.

inventory.err_cost_unknown_flag.en: {event} cannot record whether a goods cost is known

inventory.err_cost_in_patch.en: a patch cannot set a goods cost

acct.err_recon_line_created.en: This line already created a journal entry. Unmatch it first so that entry is reversed.

acct.err_recon_line_matched.en: This line is already matched. Unmatch it before creating a journal entry.

documents.err_contact_not_customer.en: {name} is not a customer. Choose a customer, or change the contact's type to customer or both.

documents.err_contact_not_vendor.en: {name} is not a vendor. Choose a vendor, or change the contact's type to vendor or both.

inventory.err_restore_only.en: A deleted item comes back only through Restore, as a draft.

inventory.err_left_books_sold.en: This item was sold; reverse its fulfilment to bring it back.

inventory.err_gave_up_stock.en: This item holds no stock on the books: it was sold, or its stock went into other items (a split, transform or merge), or its receipt or return was undone, so a status edit cannot bring it back.

inventory.err_sold_via_invoice.en: An item is sold by fulfilling its invoice, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_merged_via_merge.en: An item is merged through the Merge action, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_expired_via_expire.en: Use the Expire action to expire an item, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_reserved_via_document.en: An item is reserved by the sales order or invoice that holds it, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_memo_out_via_memo.en: An item goes out on memo by fulfilling its memo, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_deleted_via_delete.en: An item is deleted through the Delete action, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_left_books_disposed.en: This stock was written off; use Undo write-off to bring it back.

inventory.err_left_books_merged.en: This item was merged into another; use Undo merge to bring it back.

inventory.err_held_by_document.en: This item is held by document {doc}; resolve the document first (release or return the goods, or convert the document), then its status can change to {lot_status}.

inventory.err_revert_via_action.en: Use the item's 'Revert to Draft' action, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_draft_via_make_available.en: A draft item can only become available through the 'Make Available' action, not a direct status edit.

inventory.err_import_rows_invalid.en: {count} problems in the rows need changes before they can be imported.

inventory.err_import_preview_stale.en: The file, its mapping or its rows changed since the preview. Preview it again, then import.

inventory.err_create_status.en: An item is created as draft or available, not {lot_status}.

inventory.err_restate_lineage_missing.en: {lot} is merged, but its merge lineage is not recorded

inventory.err_restate_sale_untraced.en: {lot} is sold, but its sale cannot be traced to one invoice line, so its cost of goods sold cannot be adjusted automatically; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_restate_unit_cost_only.en: {lot} has a unit cost but no total cost, so a correction cannot be carried from it automatically; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_restate_returned.en: {lot} is sold, and {sku} was later returned on {doc}, so a correction cannot be carried into the returned stock automatically; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_restate_cost_used.en: {lot}'s cost was already split, transformed, or used, so the correction cannot be carried automatically

inventory.err_restate_changed_meanwhile.en: {lot} changed while the correction was being applied; try again

inventory.err_restate_merged_part.en: {lot} was merged, and a merge result's cost is the sum of its parts, so clearing the cost of one part cannot be carried automatically; correct the merge result's cost instead

inventory.err_restate_lineage_loop.en: {lot}: the merge lineage loops back on itself at {item}

inventory.err_restate_lineage_broken.en: {lot} was merged into {item}, which is not an item; the merge lineage is broken

inventory.err_restate_successor_used.en: {lot}'s cost went into {successor}, which was later split, transformed, used, or written off, so the correction cannot be carried through it automatically

inventory.err_restate_successor_negative.en: {lot}'s cost went into {successor}, whose cost cannot absorb a change of {change}

inventory.err_restate_lot_partly_priced.en: {lot} was sold on {doc}, but that invoice does not price the whole lot, so its cost of goods sold cannot be adjusted automatically; correct it with a journal entry instead

inventory.err_barcode_taken.en: Another item already has barcode {barcode}. Use a different barcode, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_barcode_taken_unnamed.en: Another item already has this barcode. Use a different barcode, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_rfid_epc_taken.en: Another item already has RFID / EPC code {code}. Use a different code, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_rfid_epc_taken_unnamed.en: Another item already has this RFID / EPC code. Use a different code, or change it on the other item first.

error.unhandled_events.en: Records can't be rebuilt while these modules are turned off: {modules} ({events}). Turn them on in Modules, then try again.

mfg.no_recipe.en: This item has no recipe to make it from.

chart.parent_is_posting_account.en: Account {parent_code} is the posting account for {roles}, so no account can sit under it.

chart.parent_missing.en: Parent account {parent_code} is not in the chart of accounts.

chart.parent_type_mismatch.en: An account of type {types} cannot sit under {parent_code}, an account of type {type}.

fixed_assets.err_not_a_date.en: {field} {value} is not a date. Enter it as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-09-30.

fixed_assets.err_after_today.en: {field} {value} is after the company's today, {today} (time zone {zone}).

fixed_assets.err_locked.en: The books are locked up to {lock}. Use a date from {first}, or ask an accountant to unlock.

fixed_assets.err_method_settings.en: Method settings are a set of named values.

fixed_assets.err_not_a_setting.en: {name} is not a setting of this method.

fixed_assets.err_total_units.en: A units-of-use class needs the total units the asset is expected to produce.

fixed_assets.err_life_months.en: The useful life is a whole number of months.

fixed_assets.err_needs_life.en: A depreciated class needs a useful life.

fixed_assets.err_choose_role_account.en: Choose the {role} account in Posting accounts first.

fixed_assets.err_reading_missing.en: Enter the reading for {period} on {number} first.

fixed_assets.err_before_available.dispos.en: The disposal date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.sale.en: The sale date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.additi.en: The addition date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.availa.en: The available-for-use date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.reclas.en: The reclassification date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.measur.en: The measurement date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.disposal.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Dispose on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.sale.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Date the sale on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.addition.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Add on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.available.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Place in service on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.reclassif.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Reclassify on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.measureme.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Measure on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_rule_not_provided.en: {rule} is not provided by any installed module.

fixed_assets.err_rule_module_off.en: {rule} needs the {module} module, which is turned off.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.sold.en: {number} was sold on {date}. Void its invoice and cancel the sale on its page first.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.disposed.en: {number} was disposed of on {date}. Undo the disposal on its page first.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.undone_from_bi.en: {number}'s registration was undone. Its bill line is back in Register from bills, to register it again.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.undone.en: {number}'s registration was undone. Register it again to bring it back.

fixed_assets.err_cannot.undo_move.en: The move of {number} cannot be undone.

fixed_assets.err_op_key.en: Every change carries an operation key from its form.

fixed_assets.err_line_released.en: This line was registered and released since you opened this form. Press Review again.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale.one.en: {assets} changed since you reviewed it. Press Review again to see it as it stands now.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale.many.en: {assets} changed since you reviewed them. Press Review again to see them as they stand now.

fixed_assets.err_ended.sold.en: {number} was sold on invoice {invoice}. Void that invoice and cancel the sale on {number}'s page, then use Correct there.

fixed_assets.err_ended.disposed.en: {number} was disposed of. Undo the disposal on its page, then use Correct there.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale_unnamed.en: An asset, account or posting on this review changed since you reviewed it. Press Review again to see it as it stands now.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.registere.en: {assets} changed since it was registered. Use Correct on its page instead.
{assets} changed since they were registered. Use Correct on each one's page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.done.one.en: {assets} changed since this was done. Use Correct on its page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.done.many.en: {assets} changed since this was done. Use Correct on each one's page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.run.one.en: {assets} changed since this run. Use Correct on its page to change its depreciation.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.run.many.en: {assets} changed since this run. Use Correct on each one's page to change its depreciation.

fixed_assets.err_run_not_reversible.en: The {month} run can no longer be reversed.

fixed_assets.err_run_posted.en: Depreciation for {month} is already posted. Open its run to see it or reverse it.

fixed_assets.err_month_not_ended.en: {month} has not ended yet. Depreciation runs for a month once it has ended, so the latest you can run through is {last}.

fixed_assets.err_import_rows_with_proble.en: Fix or leave out the rows with problems first: rows {rows}.

fixed_assets.err_import_exclude_numbers.en: Leave out rows by their row numbers.

fixed_assets.err_import_no_such_row.en: There is no row {row} in this file.

fixed_assets.err_import_no_rows.en: The file has no rows to import.

fixed_assets.err_import_too_many_rows.en: Import at most {max} rows at a time. Split the file and import each part.

fixed_assets.err_import_at_cutover.en: The register is imported as at the cutover {cutover}.

fixed_assets.err_recon_at_cutover.en: The reconciliation starts at the cutover {cutover}.

fixed_assets.err_sale_many_clearing.en: {number}: the document cleared its line through more than one account ({accounts}).

fixed_assets.err_no_such_asset.en: Celerp couldn't find this asset. It may have been deleted.

fixed_assets.err_sale_on_draft.en: {number} is on draft invoice {invoice}. Finalize or delete that invoice, or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_sale_on_void.en: {number} is waiting on void invoice {invoice}. Reissue or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_sale_draft_deleted.en: {number} is waiting on a sale whose draft invoice was deleted. Reissue or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_credit_kind.en: Choose whether the credit note credits part of the price or takes the asset back.

fixed_assets.err_credit_no_sale.en: {number} has no completed sale to credit.

fixed_assets.err_credit_over.en: Only {amount} of the sale of {number} is left to credit.

fixed_assets.err_unsell_credit_note.en: {number} has credit note {credit_note} on this invoice. Void that credit note first.

fixed_assets.err_unsell_returned.en: {number} was returned with credit note {credit_note}. Void that credit note first.

fixed_assets.err_credit_already_returned.en: {number} was already returned with a credit note on this invoice.

fixed_assets.err_return_amount.en: A return credits what is left of the sale of {number}: {amount}.

fixed_assets.err_sale_doc_by_person.en: {numbers}: a document selling or crediting an asset is changed by a person.

fixed_assets.err_sale_keep_line.en: {number} is waiting on this invoice. Keep its line, or cancel the sale from the asset's page, which voids this draft.

fixed_assets.err_sale_module_off.en: {numbers}: turn on Fixed Assets to sell an asset.

fixed_assets.err_sale_not_here.en: {number} is not being sold on this invoice. Sell it from its page, which drafts its invoice.
